items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I was playing with Johnny Gould, Louis, Louis Nass, eh? Yeah. Yeah, I was playing with them.

ctx.x: I played with Johnny Gould in them when they had that, around that Poitras when they had that crevasse. Yeah, I was playing with Johnny Gould, Louis, Louis Nass, eh? Yeah. Yeah, I was playing with them.
What about World War I, World War I, who were you playing with then? World War I, uh...

items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: But, we'd go down with Big Eye Louie, Johnny Gould, and Ford.

ctx.x: Well, we used to go down with them. I was playing trumpet with them. Yeah. Me, Big Eye Louie and all that, we sometimes had about six pieces. Yeah. And, let me see, we wasn't using no drums then. I was playing when they wasn't using no drums. Yeah, that's what I hear. In your real old days they didn't have drums. Yeah. They wasn't using no drums. Needed no piano. But, we'd go down with Big Eye Louie, Johnny Gould, and Ford. And, used to go down sometime, every Saturday we'd go to the island, Delacour Island and…

like that Boxers right there you know great big box.
